title: An integer-valued measurable density from a summable family of integer functions
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and f_j : ℝ^P → ℤ measurable (j ∈ ℕ) with Σ_j ∫⁻ |f_j| dHⁿ < ∞ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Then there is a measurable m : ℝ^P → ℝ with m(y) ∈ ℤ for every y, |m(y)| ≤ Σ_j |f_j(y)| (in [0, ∞]) for every y, and, for Hⁿ-a.e. y, the real family (f_j(y))_j is summable and m(y) = Σ_j f_j(y).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → Euclid P → ℤ), (∀ j, Measurable (f j)) → ∑' j, ∫⁻ y, ((f j y).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞ → ∃ m : Euclid P → ℝ, Measurable m ∧ (∀ y, ∃ z : ℤ, m y = z) ∧ (∀ y, ENNReal.ofReal |m y| ≤ ∑' j, ((f j y).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞)) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂μHE[n], Summable (fun j => (f j y : ℝ)) ∧ m y = ∑' j, (f j y : ℝ)
